assets.alt_text: Capstone evidence chain from observed evidence through transformations, assumptions, outputs, recommendation, and decision, with monitoring triggers and three professional pathways.
assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 PNG, 16:9. Academic capstone evidence-to-decision map for Module 10. Show the ordered chain observed evidence -> transformations -> assumptions -> outputs -> recommendation -> decision, followed by a monitoring and trigger loop back to review. Keep observed evidence and assumptions visually separate. Add three small pathway labels: Portfolio Management, Private Markets, Private Wealth. Use short exact labels only. Off-white background, navy linework, teal evidence and output accents, muted-blue pathway accents, amber decision highlights, coral trigger and limitation accents, and a 7% safe margin. No client data, fake recommendation, or confidential information.
production_notes: Generated from code so the evidence chain and monitoring loop remain exact.
The three pathways share one evidence contract; the diagram does not rank them.
